name: @w6w-apps/resend
description: Send transactional email and manage domains, audiences, contacts and broadcasts via Resend.

w6w.longDescription:
Resend is a transactional and marketing email platform, and this app sends and manages email through it: send a single transactional email or up to a hundred in one batch, and create and manage the domains, audiences, contacts and broadcasts a sending program depends on.

Both send actions support idempotency, so a retried workflow step can't accidentally send the same email twice — the key defaults to the step's own invocation id, stable across a retry and different for the next send. Domain actions cover adding a new sending domain, reading back the DNS records it needs, and asking Resend to re-verify it once those records are in place. Audience and contact actions manage subscriber lists and their subscription state, and broadcast actions draft, list and send a campaign to a chosen segment.

This app covers sending and the audience infrastructure around it; API key creation, inbound email, and Resend's templates and automation features are left out, since minting a live credential or handling raw message bodies belongs to a different kind of surface than a workflow action.
